Industries (India) Limited develops real estate and infrastructure assets, with stated business objectives spanning warehousing, data centres, residential, industrial/housing and IT/ITES facilities. drhp.expansion: During FY26 the Company completed acquisition of approximately 58.90 acres of contiguous land at Santhavellore Village, Sriperumbudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District, Tamil Nadu, extending its existing land holdings for integrated, large-scale development (logistics parks, industrial and commercial developments, warehousing, data centres). demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's IMF growth projection retained at 6.5% for FY27, supported by robust domestic demand, reduced US tariff rates and resilience despite external headwinds.
- Union Budget infrastructure-led capital expenditure allocation of Rs 11.21 lakh crore for FY26, marginally higher than the prior year, driving development in transportation, energy and urban mobility.
- Indian real estate sector viewed as being at the confluence of policy support, population growth and economic ambition, with commercial office leasing, retail, residential and logistics/industrial demand all expected to strengthen.
- Decarbonisation and digital transformation (PropTech, IoT, AI, big data) cited as the two most transformative forces reshaping real estate over the coming decades.
- Data centre colocation capacity expected to rise, supported by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and the draft National Data Center Policy, with growing investment interest in Tier 2 cities.
- Institutional investment into Indian real estate surpassed USD 7.5 billion in 2025, an all-time high, with REITs and CAPEX pipelines cited as continuing growth and liquidity drivers for the sector.
- Projects in the pipeline: a logistics park on 400 acres at Sunguvarchatram, Kanchipuram District, and a joint venture with the Prestige Group (Bangalore) for IT/ITES parks in Chennai.

capex_expansion.body: During FY26 the Company completed acquisition of approximately 58.90 acres of contiguous land at Santhavellore Village, Sriperumbudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District, Tamil Nadu, extending its existing land holdings for integrated, large-scale development (logistics parks, industrial and commercial developments, warehousing, data centres). The Company is pursuing further land acquisition and has begun readying already-acquired parcels. Two named projects are in the pipeline: a logistics park on 400 acres of land at Sunguvarchatram, Kanchipuram District, and a joint venture with the Prestige Group (Bangalore) for development of IT/ITES parks in Chennai — the latter, undertaken through subsidiary WSI Falcon Infra Projects Private Limited, saw preliminary development activities, planning exercises and regulatory processes during the year and is awaiting key statutory and regulatory approvals for further implementation.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company states its reduction in turnover was primarily attributable to the substantial completion and closure of major ongoing projects during the year, indicating revenue is structurally lumpy and tied to the completion/closure timing of a small number of large projects rather than a recurring revenue base.
- The Company relies on an unsecured Inter-Corporate Deposit from its subsidiary WSI Falcon Infra Projects Private Limited to support business commitments and working capital requirements.
- Outstanding secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures are secured, inter alia, by a charge over certain immovable properties of subsidiary WSI Falcon Infra Projects Private Limited, linking the parent's financing to subsidiary asset encumbrance.
- The Joint Venture undertaken by subsidiary WSI Falcon Infra Projects Private Limited with the Prestige Group for IT/ITES park development in Chennai is presently awaiting certain key statutory and regulatory approvals before further implementation can proceed.
- Further growth depends on the Company's ability to identify, diligence and acquire additional land parcels and to finalise contracts on already-acquired parcels; the Company itself flags that it undertakes ongoing legal, technical and commercial due diligence and prudent risk management for these acquisitions.
- MD&A notes the global outlook has deteriorated amid surging energy prices, commodity market disruptions, elevated uncertainty and tighter monetary conditions, with global growth expected to decline this year before firming in 2027-28 — a backdrop relevant to real estate and institutional investment demand.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Build a diversified growth platform across three verticals — Real Estate, IT Infrastructure, and Warehousing & Logistics — intended to deliver sustainable earnings, strong cash flows and long-term value creation.
- Expand the real estate project pipeline through strategic land acquisitions, joint development agreements and partnerships with landowners, focused on high-growth urban corridors and emerging suburban markets.
- Expand presence in IT infrastructure assets and technology-enabled developments, including data centres, technology parks and managed office ecosystems.
- Develop warehousing parks, logistics hubs and industrial infrastructure assets near key transportation corridors and consumption centres.
- Maintain financial discipline in capital allocation — a healthy balance sheet, investment in high-return opportunities, and optimised project execution cycles.
- Strengthen project execution capabilities and operational efficiency while pursuing new opportunities in the infrastructure sector.
